description:
We are Health Signal, a team of two from Switzerland at the Lucerne local event: space enthusiasts who love to explore ideas outside our own domain.

Tamas Kaljuste: business development executive in digital transformation and an AI practitioner focused on practical applications and rapid prototyping. He leads the architecture, the data choices and the build with AI agents.

Sven: young student and co-designer, with the unexpected questions and bold ideas that move the project forward. He decides what looks right and whether an explanation makes sense to a young astronaut.

Our mission: bring the astronauts back from Mars alive, in as good health as possible. Our vision: share what we learn to improve life on Earth.
